---
title: "`{r} pkg_name`: `{r} packageDescription(pkg_name, fields = 'Title')`"
date: "`{r} Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r, order = 0, include = FALSE}
litedown::reactor(echo = FALSE)
# package description
pkg_name = litedown:::detect_pkg()
pkg_path = attr(pkg_name, 'path')
readme = litedown:::pkg_readme(pkg_name)
has_readme = !is.null(readme)
# if man/figures exists and used, copy it to current dir
fig = file.path(pkg_path, 'man/figures')
if (!xfun::same_path('.', pkg_path) && dir.exists(fig)) {
  xfun::dir_create('man')
  file.copy(fig, 'man', recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r, results = 'asis'}
# the logo (e.g., a hex sticker), if exists; floated right by .logo in site.css
xfun::raw_string(litedown:::pkg_logo(pkg_name, readme))
```

```{r}
# with a README, put a compact description in the sidebar; otherwise show the
# full description in the main column
litedown::pkg_desc(pkg_name, if (has_readme) 'dl' else 'table')
```

```{r, results = 'asis'}
# readme, if exists
if (has_readme) xfun::raw_string(readme)
```

## Citation {-}

To cite the package **`{r} pkg_name`** in publications, please use:

```{r, warning = FALSE}
litedown::pkg_citation(pkg_name)
```
